name: Rococo
intro: Rococo is the light, curving, pastel style of Paris, Venice and Bavaria in the decades after 1715. Each picture here shows one thing to look for.
homeDescription: How to recognize Rococo, from Watteau, Boucher and Fragonard to Tiepolo, Carriera and the Wieskirche, in a short illustrated guide.
ldDescription: A short guide to recognizing Rococo art in France, Venice and Bavaria, about 1717 to 1772, compiled from museum collection records.
sourcesDescription: Lectures, curricula, museum collection records and reference sources used to compile {name}.
